name: Stellar Crossroads
source:
Some 150 years after the Hive war, you play the role of a former miner, thrust into the limelight following the inheritance of a space station. Shape the course of future events in the Orion Sector as rival factions seek to exert control.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/xavster_gaming/about]Patreon[/url]]
